scenario_summary: Baseline control case: a well-documented vendor whose claims are consistently supported by attached evidence, plus one claim (24/7 monitoring) that is asserted but never actually evidenced by any attached document. Tests that a strong verification system doesn't over-flag a clean package, while still catching the one genuine unsupported claim.

claims.subject: SOC 2 Type II examination
claims.source_excerpt: Northwind has completed a SOC 2 Type II examination covering the Security and Availability trust service criteria.
claims.evidence_requirement: SOC 2 report confirming Type II scope and an unqualified opinion for the stated criteria.

evidence_items.excerpt: Report type: SOC 2 Type II; Trust service criteria: Security, Availability; Auditor opinion: Unqualified

claims.subject: encryption at rest
claims.source_excerpt: All customer data at rest is encrypted using AES-256.
claims.evidence_requirement: Independent confirmation (e.g. SOC report tested-control entry) that AES-256 at-rest encryption is actually operating, not just stated.

evidence_items.excerpt: Encryption at rest: Customer data stored in the production database and object storage tiers is encrypted using AES-256. Control operated effectively throughout the audit period.

claims.subject: penetration testing
claims.source_excerpt: Northwind engages an independent third-party firm to perform a penetration test of the production environment on an annual basis.
claims.evidence_requirement: SOC report or attestation confirming penetration testing was actually performed within the claimed cadence.

evidence_items.excerpt: Vulnerability and penetration testing: An independent third-party penetration test of the production environment is performed annually. The most recent test was completed 2025-06-15.

claims.subject: data retention after termination
claims.source_excerpt: Northwind shall delete or return all customer personal data within 30 days, except where retention is required by applicable law.
claims.evidence_requirement: None beyond the DPA itself — this is a contractual commitment, not a technical claim requiring separate evidence.

evidence_items.excerpt: Northwind shall delete or return all customer personal data within 30 days, except where retention is required by applicable law.

claims.expected_handling_notes: Contractual commitments sourced from a single authoritative document (the DPA itself) are 'supported' by that document's existence; no second, independent evidence item is required unless another document contradicts it.

claims.subject: sub-processor obligations
claims.source_excerpt: Northwind shall impose data protection obligations on each sub-processor that are substantially equivalent to those set out in this Addendum.

evidence_items.excerpt: Northwind shall impose data protection obligations on each sub-processor that are substantially equivalent to those set out in this Addendum.

claims.subject: 24/7 security monitoring
claims.source_excerpt: Northwind's Security Operations function provides 24/7 monitoring of production systems for security events.
claims.evidence_requirement: An independent source (e.g. a SOC report tested-control entry covering monitoring/logging operations) confirming continuous monitoring is actually operating, not just staffing claimed in the questionnaire.
claims.expected_handling_notes: The SOC report's tested-control list does not include a monitoring/logging control, only encryption, penetration testing, and access control. A correct system should flag this specific claim as unverified rather than accepting it because the rest of the package is credible, and should not treat 'the vendor is otherwise well-documented' as evidence for this specific, unevidenced claim.
